summary: BBCMS Mortgage Trust 2020-C6 filed a routine Form 8-K under Item 8.01 reporting that CWCapital Asset Management LLC was removed and Torchlight Loan Services, LLC appointed successor special servicer for the 545 Washington Boulevard Mortgage Loan, roughly 5.6% of the asset pool at cut-off, effective September 10, 2026, under the BANK 2020-BNK25 pooling and servicing agreement. No price, stake, premium, board recommendation, or advisor is stated; the filing merely records the servicing transfer in the interest of transaction management. Watch for any subsequent special servicing or delinquency disclosures on this loan.
